title: The Day of the Odd Invention
skyStory: The moon has floated into Aquarius at seventy-seven percent, and it has brought a box of spare parts. Aquarius is the inventor of the zodiac, the one who builds a bird feeder out of a colander and calls it art. Tonight the moon is tinkering with the tides, trying to make them run sideways. Mars hands it tools. Saturn reads the warranty.

reading: Aquarius moon plus a builder's brain equals one gloriously strange idea before lunch. Maybe a shelf that folds into a bench. Maybe a new way of sorting the cabin's mystery-key drawer. It will sound ridiculous out loud. Say it out loud anyway.

Then find one person who thinks it's brilliant and one who thinks it's bonkers, and listen to both. The [[Page of Swords]] loves a fresh idea but wants you to test it before you build it. Sketch it on the back of an envelope. Leave the envelope somewhere visible. Next week, you'll look at it and know.
joel.mission: Sketch one odd invention on the back of an envelope and leave it pinned somewhere you'll see daily.
joel.omen: A machine making an unusual noise that turns out to be fine. Weird isn't broken; sometimes it's brilliant.

reading: The Wood Rat has always been a little bit Aquarius at heart: clever, unconventional, quietly three steps ahead. Today that streak comes out to play. You'll solve a stubborn problem using a method nobody else would have tried, and it'll work on the first go.

Somebody will ask how you thought of it. Tell them the truth, which is that you noticed something odd last Tuesday and kept it in your pocket until it was useful. That's the whole secret of the Wood Rat. [[The Magician]] reversed reminds you that every tool is already on the table. You don't need a new one. You need the weird one.
nancy.mission: Solve one ordinary problem today in the strangest way that still works, and tell Joel how you did it.
nancy.omen: A piece of string tied in a bow on a fence post. A small, clever fix is waiting for you to notice it.
nancy.stoneWhy: grounding for a flighty, clever day

together.text: Invention swap: each of you describe one ridiculous gadget that would make the other's day easier. Joel's must involve the shore. Nancy's must involve the cabin. Patents pending. The Aquarius moon will build none of them but applauds the vision.
